page.content:
Chinese empire that first institutionalized the Western Regions traffic.

How Han dynasty connects

  • Character: Emperor Wu of Han — Emperor Wu drove Han expansion into the corridor and the Tarim.
  • Location: Chang'an — The Han court that opened the west sat at Chang'an.
  • Item: Ferghana horses — The Han fought and bargained for Ferghana horses.

What is Han dynasty?

The Han dynasty created the protectorate system in the Tarim, imported Ferghana horses, and exported silk that Parthians and Romans already craved.

Key threads lead to Emperor Wu of Han, Chang'an and Ferghana horses.
